Class WhoJwtAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.autoconfigure.WhoJwtAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after={WhoAutoConfiguration.class,WhoFederatedAutoConfiguration.class}) @EnableConfigurationProperties(WhoProperties.class) @ConditionalOnClass(name="org.jwcarman.who.jwt.WhoJwtAuthenticationConverter") @ConditionalOnBooleanProperty(name="who.jwt.enabled", matchIfMissing=true) public class WhoJwtAutoConfiguration extends Object
Registers JWT beans when who-jwt is on the classpath.

  • Method Details

    • whoJwtAuthenticationConverter

      @Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public WhoJwtAuthenticationConverter whoJwtAuthenticationConverter(FederatedCredentialRepository federatedCredentialRepository, WhoService whoService, WhoEventPublisher whoEventPublisher, Clock clock)
      The converter that signs JWTs in, publishing the sign-in events.
      Parameters:
      federatedCredentialRepository - looks credentials up by issuer and subject
      whoService - resolves a credential to its identity
      whoEventPublisher - where the sign-in events are published
      clock - stamps the events
      Returns:
      the converter

    • jwtLoginMethod

      @Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public JwtLoginMethod jwtLoginMethod(WhoJwtAuthenticationConverter converter, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.JwtDecoder> decoders, org.springframework.core.env.Environment environment)
      Mounts JWT sign-in in a chain built with WhoSecurity.all(). The JwtDecoder is looked up when the chain is built: Spring Boot makes one from spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri or jwk-set-uri, and without one the chain fails to start.
      Parameters:
      converter - signs a verified JWT in
      decoders - the application's decoder
      environment - where Spring Boot's resource-server properties are read
      Returns:
      the login method
